D/ D N GRATIAN VS AVGG AVG ; R/ GLORIA ROMANORVM

A Roman copper alloy nummus of Gratian, GLORIA ROMANORVM reverse depicting emperor advancing right holding labarum and dragging captive from left. Probably Mint of Siscia, AD 367-375 (Reece period 19). Dimensions: diameter: 17.38mm; weight: 2.09g. Obverse description: Diademed, draped cuirassed bust right. Obverse inscription: D N GRATIAN VS AVGG AVG. Reverse description: Emperor advancing right…
